beats.care: If you have asthma, go easy on outdoor runs near busy roads. Report open waste burning to PMC.
beats.what: SAFAR readings on Monday ranged from 112 in Pashan to 144 in Hadapsar. PMC acted against five to six unpermitted plants in Bavdhan.
beats.why: Dry weather plus construction dust, waste burning and traffic keep pollution hanging over the city.

cards.body: The worst in the city on Monday, still in the 'moderate' band.
cards.caption: Hadapsar AQI (SAFAR)

cards.body: PMC also demolished over 35,000 sq ft of illegal structures put up by the plants, City Engineer Aniruddha Pawaskar said.
Monsoon's exit helps clear skies, but without rain to wash dust away, Pune's air gets worse.

opts: They ran without permissions and caused dust
cards.q: Why did PMC act against plants in Bavdhan?
cards.why: PMC shut ready-mix concrete plants operating without required permissions after dust complaints.

hook: Pune's air has slipped for *three days straight*. Who's to blame?

learn.t: Ready-mix concrete plants and stone crushers are among the dust sources blamed for Pune's worsening air.
